title: Private 2 Day Banff National Park Tour From Edmonton
includes: This is a fully private tour – only your group will participate
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries

cancellation:
If you cancel at least 3 full day(s) before the scheduled departure time, you will receive a full refund.
If you cancel within 3 day(s) of the scheduled departure, you will receive a 0% refund.
blurb:
Explore Banff National Park on this private 2-day tour from Edmonton, traveling in a brand new luxury Volkswagen ID. Buzz electric van designed for high comfort, quiet travel, and panoramic views. This is a fully private tour, meaning the vehicle and guide are exclusively for you and your group.

During the tour, you will visit Lake Louise, Moraine Lake, Johnston Canyon, Lake Minnewanka, Bow Falls, Surprise Corner, Banff Town, and enjoy a scenic drive along Bow Valley Parkway. The tour is designed to be comfortable, flexible, and relaxed, with plenty of time for sightseeing and photos.

Accommodation and meals are not included, giving you the flexibility to choose your preferred hotel and dining in Banff. If you would like to customize the itinerary, you can contact us before the tour.
